name: Bank for International Settlements — BIS Data Portal SDMX API (stats.bis.org)

rate_limit.source: No limit published; the API terms reserve the right to monitor usage and to limit or suspend an IP address (data.bis.org/help/legal, read 2026-10-23). Self-imposed: one request every 2 s.

failure_behavior: 429/5xx: bounded backoff, then the run fails; stored values keep their availability times. An empty OBS_VALUE is skipped with a reason, never zero.

datasets.description: Central bank policy rates (WS_CBPOL), monthly end of period, percent: US (mid-point of the Federal Reserve target range), IN (Reserve Bank of India policy repo rate), XM (ECB; applies to every euro-area country)
datasets.coverage: US, IN and the euro area (all EU countries in config/markets/venues.json use EUR)
datasets.history_depth: Monthly from the 1950s for the US; per-series depth as published
datasets.update_frequency: Weekly to monthly updates by the BIS
datasets.availability_rule: A policy rate in force on the last day of a month is public by then: backfill is available at 23:59:59 UTC on the last day of the month (flag availability_estimated_backfill); a live capture is available at receipt. A changed value on re-fetch is a new publication at receipt time flagged revised_after_first_seen.
datasets.rights_source: BIS statistics terms (data.bis.org/help/legal, read 2026-10-23): 'The use of the statistics is unrestricted, provided that' the BIS is cited as the source and inclusion adds no charge to users; use of the APIs means agreeing to the API terms (no modification or redistribution of the APIs). Verdict: allowed for single-owner research with citation 'Source: BIS central bank policy rates'; cloud-model processing withheld until the owner decides.
